name: Hark
notes: Hark Labs' personal assistant in a browser and iOS and Android apps: books tables and flights, orders food, handles email and expenses, compares insurance quotes and hands off research and site-building to its own agents. Requested via the form (issue #483).
tagline: Whatever you need, let Hark handle it
